jobs.description:

This is a rare opportunity to join an early-stage, research-first AI company working on frontier problems across autonomous agents, human intent understanding, reinforcement learning and post-training. The successful candidate will own ambitious research bets end to end, helping shape both the research agenda and the underlying models powering long-horizon agent capabilities.

Salary on offer is up to $650,000.

jobs.description:
Software Engineer

Location:
New York City
Employment Type:
Full-time
Experience:
2+ years
Focus:
AI-Native Engineering, GTM Automation, Revenue Technology, Full-Stack Product Engineering

About Our Client

Our client is building an AI-powered platform that helps go-to-market teams turn customer interactions into structured data, insights, and intelligent action.
Their AI agents help sales and revenue organizations execute faster, learn continuously, and make every deal cycle more efficient and predictable. The company is building at the intersection of AI, automation, conversational intelligence, and the modern revenue stack.
This is an opportunity to join a fast-growing, venture-backed startup with strong product-market fit, a sharp technical team, and a mission to redefine how revenue teams work.

About the Role

Our client is hiring a Software Engineer
to help design, build, and scale core product features across the platform.

This is a high-ownership engineering role for someone who can take ambiguous product requirements, break them down, design a clean solution, ship production-quality code, and own the feature through launch, monitoring, and iteration.

The team works AI-first. Engineers are expected to use LLMs, coding agents, and AI-assisted workflows to move quickly without sacrificing quality, reliability, or long-term maintainability.

What You’ll Do

Own product features end-to-end, from problem definition through design, development, testing, launch, monitoring, and support
Break down product requirements into clear technical plans and shipped outcomes
Build simple, elegant systems and write high-quality code that other engineers can easily understand and extend
Collaborate closely with product, design, and engineering to turn ideas into production features
Influence product direction with your own ideas and identify ways to improve user workflows and business processes
Balance immediate business needs with long-term architecture and platform quality
Build across backend, frontend, infrastructure, and AI systems depending on the problem
Use AI tools, LLMs, and agents as part of the software development lifecycle
Build testing, monitoring, and reliability into the way features are shipped
Help scale a platform used by modern go-to-market teams to improve sales execution and customer intelligence

What We’re Looking For

2+ years of professional software engineering experience
Fluency with AI-forward software development workflows using LLMs, agents, or AI coding tools
Experience building production-grade software without sacrificing quality for speed
Strong fundamentals in software design and knowing when to apply patterns like SOLID or similar principles
Ability to take ambiguous problems and turn them into well-reasoned designs and shipped solutions
Comfort owning features end-to-end across frontend and backend systems
Strong autonomy, ownership, and bias toward action
Experience building, launching, and maintaining products in fast-paced environments
Strong collaboration skills across product, design, engineering, and customer-facing stakeholders
Grit, adaptability, and comfort navigating ambiguity in an early-stage environment

Technical Experience

Our client is especially interested in engineers with experience in one or more of the following areas:
Go or another strongly typed backend language
Distributed systems, infrastructure, or scaling
LLM harnesses or agentic systems
Concurrent or asynchronous processing
Testing, monitoring, observability, and reliability
Full-stack product engineering

Technical Environment

Relevant technologies include: Go, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes, AWS, Kafka, Redit, Temporal Workflows, React, Tailwind, Next.js, GraphQL, LLMs and AI Agents.

Experience with every tool is not required. Strong engineering fundamentals, product ownership, and AI-native development ability matter more than exact stack match.

Why This Opportunity

Join a fast-growing AI startup with strong product-market fit
Build at the intersection of AI, automation, conversational intelligence, and revenue technology
Work on products that help sales and go-to-market teams operate faster and smarter
Own meaningful features from concept through production
Use AI-native engineering workflows as a core part of daily development
Work with a sharp, collaborative team of repeat founders and experienced engineers
Help shape the future of how revenue teams turn conversations into action

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity
Choice of new equipment and software
Health, dental, and vision insurance
High autonomy and ownership at work

jobs.title: Agentic AI Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure Automation
jobs.description:
Hello,
UnivEdge Consulting is hiring for one of our direct clients - a global technology consulting leader based in the US. Immediate interviews for the below position.

Role: Agentic AI Engineer - Cloud Infrastructure Automation

Location: US, Remote

Contractual (W2/C2C)

Role Summary

We are seeking an Agentic AI Engineer to design and deliver AI agents that operate against live cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on build role: you will stand up agent workflows that interpret infrastructure state and telemetry, generate and validate Infrastructure-as-Code, and execute controlled remediation and provisioning actions under human-in-the-loop approval.
This is not a research or prototyping role. The expectation is working, governed automation deployed into a real environment within the engagement window.

Key Responsibilities

Build and deploy agentic workflows using an LLM orchestration framework (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel, or cloud-native equivalents such as Bedrock Agents / Azure AI Agent Service)
Design and implement tool/function-calling layers that expose infrastructure operations to agents safely — including MCP-based tooling where applicable
Generate, review and validate Terraform modules programmatically; integrate policy-as-code checks (OPA/Sentinel, tflint, checkov) into agent output paths
Integrate agents with observability and ITSM systems (DataDog, ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira) for alert triage and automated ticket-to-action flows
Implement guardrails: least-privilege execution roles, approval gates, dry-run/plan-only modes, audit logging of every agent action
Build evaluation and regression harnesses for agent behaviour (accuracy, tool-selection correctness, failure containment)
Wire agent workflows into existing CI/CD pipelines
Document architecture and hand over to the client's platform team at engagement close

Required Skills

Agentic AI / LLM

2+ years building production LLM applications, including at least one deployed multi-step agentic system
Strong command of one orchestration framework (LangGraph/LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) plus tool/function calling and structured output
Practical experience with agent guardrails, retries, failure handling and human-in-the-loop approval design
RAG fundamentals: embeddings, vector stores (pgvector, OpenSearch, Pinecone), retrieval quality tuning
Agent evaluation and observability (LangSmith, Langfuse, Ragas, or equivalent custom harnesses)

Infrastructure / Platform

5+ years in cloud infrastructure, platform or DevOps engineering
Deep Terraform: module design, state and remote backends, workspaces, drift handling; Terragrunt or Terraform Cloud/Enterprise a plus
Policy-as-code: OPA/Rego, Sentinel, or equivalent
Cloud depth in at least one of AWS / Azure / OCI, including IAM and least-privilege design
CI/CD: GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab CI or Jenkins
Containers and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
Observability tooling - DataDog strongly preferred

Engineering

Expert-level Python (async, API integration, testing)
Secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault)
Git-based workflows and code review discipline

Show more

Show less

Mid-Senior level

Employment type

Contract

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting and Staffing and Recruiting
